claims.claim: Harry Bains is Surrey's only opposition councillor and challenged Mayor Doug McCallum's 16 priority projects at Monday's first regular council meeting.
claims.episode_span: Coun. Harry Bains, the only councillor not on Mayor Doug McCallum's Safe Surrey Coalition, used Monday's first regular meeting
claims.source_title: Surrey's only opposition councillor kicks off term challenging mayor's 16 priority projects
claims.supporting_quote: At the first regular council meeting since the election, on Monday, Bains made his stand clear on the 16 promises McCallum wants to implement.

claims.claim: Bains supports a hospital but wants a women's and children's hospital on a larger site than the three-hectare site the mayor offered the province.
claims.episode_span: wants a women's and children's hospital on a larger site than the three hectares the mayor has offered the province
claims.source_title: Surrey's only opposition councillor kicks off term challenging mayor's 16 priority projects
claims.supporting_quote: The councillor said he supports McCallum’s hospital plan, but wants a women’s and children’s hospital rather than another general hospital, and thinks it should be built on a larger site than the three hectare one the mayor has offered the province for the project.

claims.claim: Bains voted against five motions, including a helicopter and drone fleet unless the police board requests them, and did not support a four-year property-tax freeze without guarantees against service cuts, land sales, cancelled projects, or other fee increases.
claims.episode_span: He voted against five motions, including a helicopter and drone fleet
claims.source_title: Surrey's only opposition councillor kicks off term challenging mayor's 16 priority projects
claims.supporting_quote: Bains did vote against five motions, including buying a helicopter and drone fleet for the Surrey Police Service.

claims.claim: McCallum's plans moving ahead include SkyTrain to Newton, withdrawing from Metro Vancouver, and free licences for two years for every new business.
claims.episode_span: including a call for SkyTrain to Newton, withdrawal from Metro Vancouver, and free licences for two years
claims.source_title: Surrey's only opposition councillor kicks off term challenging mayor's 16 priority projects
claims.supporting_quote: Regardless of Bains’s opposition to some proposals, every plan of McCallum’s is moving ahead, including calling for SkyTrain to Newton, withdrawing from Metro Vancouver and providing free licences for two years to every new business.

claims.claim: Homicide detectives were called to the 1000 block of East 52nd Avenue after officers were first called around 12:45 a.m., where a man, 27, and a woman, 35, were found dead.
claims.episode_span: Homicide detectives were called to a home in the 1000 block of East 52nd Avenue

claims.supporting_quote: Police said homicide detectives were called to the home in the 1000 block of East 52nd Avenue after officers were first called there around 12:45 a.m.

claims.claim: The Ministry of Forests preliminary report says parts of the Cariboo have a high risk of landslides, floods and debris flow after the Pear Lake wildfire.
claims.episode_span: A preliminary report from B.C.'s Ministry of Forests says there is a high risk of landslides
claims.source_title: Risk of landslides in Cariboo following Pear Lake wildfire: report
claims.supporting_quote: There is a high risk of landslides, floods and debris flow in parts of the Cariboo region after a massive wildfire earlier this year, according to a preliminary report released by B.C.’s Ministry of Forests.

claims.supporting_quote: The Vancouver Humane Society, the Okanagan Humane Society, Paws for Hope, Regional Animal Protection Society, Langley Animal Protection Society all have seen a dramatic uptick in demand for their low-cost treatments in recent years and say they don’t have the capacity to meet it.
